title: Stable Odd-Even Arrangement
description: Rearrange an array so that all odd numbers appear before all even numbers while preserving the original relative order among odd numbers and among even numbers.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers.
hints: Think about maintaining two output groups while scanning the array once.

examples.explanation: Odd values retain their original order, and even values retain theirs.
There are no odd values, so the array remains unchanged.
